title: Independent regional context: Sudochye open water
publisher: Scientific-Information Center of the Interstate Commission for Water Coordination (SIC ICWC)
geographic_scope: Sudochye lake system (named Sudoche in the reports), Southern Aral Sea region, Karakalpakstan. Source monitoring polygons differ from the NISAR selection.
summary: Published Landsat-based monitoring reports less open water at Sudochye between the June and September reference dates.
limitations: Regional context does not validate individual detector flags, the flagged area, detection accuracy, or a physical cause.
Reference dates differ from the radar dates. Seasonal changes can occur within these gaps.
The reference maps have different extents and are not aligned to the SAR grid. Their blue areas are the publisher's water classification, not this app's change mask.
next_check: Locate the same flagged and unflagged sites in optical images near both radar dates; assess clouds, boundary alignment, and water gain or loss before labeling detections.

observations.source_locator: Table 3, Sudoche row, PDF page 5; also June report Table 2, PDF page 3
